evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as a proportionality distinction — what you keep versus what you pay to use — enacting a cost/benefit framing of relational position.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Calls the perspective an 'asset you keep,' framing relational position as retained value against a commoditized substrate — proportionality between what is pooled and what is held.
